title: Predictions: The World Tomorrow
summary: Practica cómo hacer predicciones sobre el futuro usando will y won't en inglés.
keyIdeas: Usamos 'will' seguido del verbo en infinitivo sin 'to' para predecir el futuro (ej. 'Cars will fly').
La forma negativa es 'won't' (will not), y tampoco cambia con he, she o it.
Para preguntar, colocamos 'Will' al principio de la frase (ej. 'Will robots cook?').

activities.prompt: Look at those dark clouds! 🌧️ It ___ rain this afternoon.
activities.explanation: Usamos 'will' para hacer predicciones de futuro. Además, 'will' nunca cambia ni añade 's'.
activities.hint: Recuerda que para el futuro usamos la palabra auxiliar 'will'.

activities.prompt: 'People won't live on Mars' means that people are definitely going to live on Mars.
activities.explanation: 'Won't' es la forma negativa de 'will'. Por lo tanto, la frase significa que las personas no vivirán en Marte.
activities.hint: 'Won't' es la forma corta de 'will not'.

activities.prompt: Completa la frase con la forma correcta de futuro:
activities.explanation: La estructura de futuro es 'will' más el verbo en infinitivo sin 'to'.
activities.hint: Después del sujeto ponemos directamente 'will' antes del verbo principal.
activities.sentence: In the year 2050, robots ___ help doctors in hospitals.

activities.prompt: Match each plan with the future sentence that describes it. Plans can change.
activities.explanation: Relacionamos planes anunciados con frases en futuro. Una predicción o un plan no garantiza que algo vaya a ocurrir.

pairs.left: Leo has a train ticket for tomorrow.
pairs.right: He will travel by train tomorrow.

pairs.left: The class plans a museum visit on Friday.
pairs.right: They will visit the museum on Friday.

pairs.left: Hugo has arranged to call his cousin tonight.
pairs.right: He will call his cousin tonight.

pairs.left: Martina has booked a swimming lesson for Saturday.
pairs.right: She will go swimming on Saturday.

activities.prompt: Clasifica estas predicciones según sean afirmativas o negativas:
activities.explanation: Las frases con 'will' son afirmativas y las frases con 'won't' son negativas.

items.text: Cars will fly over the cities.
Houses will produce their own energy.

activities.prompt: Completa la pregunta sobre el futuro:
activities.explanation: Para formular preguntas de predicción en futuro, colocamos 'Will' al principio de la frase.
activities.hint: Las preguntas sobre predicciones de futuro empiezan por el verbo auxiliar.
activities.sentence: ___ people travel to the Moon for holidays?

activities.prompt: Ordena las palabras para formar una predicción correcta:
activities.explanation: El orden natural en inglés es: complemento temporal, sujeto (we), auxiliar (will), verbo (travel) y resto de la frase.

activities.prompt: Omar and Aisha are talking about school in the future. Omar says: 'Teachers ___ us, but computers will help.'
activities.explanation: Detrás de 'will' siempre usamos el verbo en su forma base (teach), sin añadir 's' ni 'to'.
activities.hint: El verbo principal va en su forma base (infinitivo sin 'to' y sin 's').

activities.prompt: Lee el texto de Aisha sobre el futuro y responde a las preguntas:
activities.explanation: El texto nos muestra predicciones de Aisha sobre el cole, el transporte y el medio ambiente usando 'will' y 'will not'.
activities.title: Life in the Future by Aisha
activities.text:
Life in the Future by Aisha.
I think our world will be very different in fifty years. Students will not carry heavy backpacks because computers will hold all our lessons. Teachers will explain difficult projects, but helpful robots will organise the materials. In the playground, children will play games with interactive holograms. Also, flying buses will carry people to work and school, so traffic jams will disappear. We will use clean energy from the sun and wind. I think the future will be green and fun!

questions.prompt: Why won't students carry heavy backpacks in the future?
questions.explanation: El texto explica claramente: 'Students will not carry heavy backpacks because computers will hold all our lessons'.
options: Because robots will carry their heavy bags.
Because students won't go to school.
Because computers will hold all their lessons.

questions.prompt: Where will clean energy come from?
questions.explanation: Aisha menciona explícitamente: 'We will use clean energy from the sun and wind'.

activities.prompt: Ordena las palabras para hacer una pregunta sobre el futuro:
activities.explanation: Para preguntar en futuro seguimos la estructura: Will + sujeto (robots) + verbo base (cook) + complementos (our dinner?).
